name: jetpack-joust
title: Jetpack Joust
summary: Fly a jetpack robot and out-joust another robot in a 60-second duel.

brief.goal:
You fly a jetpack robot in a 60-second joust against another robot, in an arena 80 m in radius under a 50 m ceiling, with six platforms to land on. Land your lance on its body and keep its lance off yours.

Each turn, send a thrust and a turn rate, and whether to strike. The jet burns or it doesn't: once lit it burns at least 20 turns, once cut it stays cold 24, so flight is a rhythm of burns and falls under 2.4× earth's gravity. A strike runs on its own: the lance extends in a quarter second, holds, retracts and recharges, about 1.5 s in all.

The other robot is a house bot, or in practice a copy of your own agent. You see it only while your chase camera does.
brief.scoring:
A lance hit on the other robot's body is +1 to you and −1 to it. A hit while your lance is still extending is a power hit: it also knocks the victim back and staggers its turning for a second. The same robot can score on the other again only after half a second. Shields stop lances; blocks and knockouts score nothing.

Score: 50 + 2 × your hit differential (hits landed less hits taken), within 0 to 100. 50 is even; 100 is 25 hits ahead.
brief.ending: Every match runs 3,600 turns: 60 seconds at 60 turns a second. Touching the floor or leaving the arena knocks you out for two seconds, then you respawn where you started. The higher differential places first; more time at 10 to 40 m breaks a tie.
brief.reward: Your change in hit differential this turn: +1, −1 or 0.

inputs.name: me
inputs.doc: Your robot. Positions are in your own frame of the arena: you start on −z facing +z, toward where the other robot starts, and the arena's axis is x = z = 0. Both seats see the arena this way.

slices.name: position
slices.doc: Where you are in your frame of the arena: x and z from the arena's axis, y above the floor.

slices.name: yaw
slices.doc: Your heading: 0 faces +z, positive is turned to your left (counter-clockwise seen from above).

slices.name: velocity
slices.doc: Your velocity in your robot's frame: x to your left, y up, z forward.

slices.name: jet
slices.doc: The thrust your jet is burning this turn, in your robot's frame, each part a share of its maximum. All 0 while the jet is cold.

slices.name: lance
slices.doc: How far your lance is out: 0 retracted (3.8 m of reach), 1 full (7.9 m).

slices.name: down
slices.doc: Turns until you respawn after a knockout (120 to 1); 0 while you fly.

inputs.name: other
inputs.doc: The other robot, relative to yours, while your chase camera can see any part of it, its lance included. The camera sits behind and above you and sees 60° up and down at 16:9.

slices.name: visible
slices.doc: 1 while your chase camera can see the other robot, else 0 and every other part is 0.

slices.name: position
slices.doc: Its position less yours, in your robot's frame: x to your left, y up, z forward.

slices.name: velocity
slices.doc: Its velocity less yours, in your robot's frame.

slices.name: yaw
slices.doc: Its heading less yours: 0 it faces the way you face; ±π it faces back toward you.

slices.name: jet
slices.doc: The thrust its jet is burning this turn, in its own robot's frame.

slices.name: lance
slices.doc: How far its lance is out, 0 to 1. Rising means a strike is coming.

slices.name: down
slices.doc: Turns until it respawns; 0 while it flies.

slices.name: differential
slices.doc: Hits you landed less hits you took.

slices.name: thrust
slices.doc: Thrust in your robot's frame: x to your left, y up, z forward, each a share of its maximum (up lifts 2.2× your weight; forward and sideways push 1×). The jet lights only when this vector's length is 0.55 or more, so hovering in place (about 0.45 up) is impossible: burn and fall.

slices.name: yaw
slices.doc: Turn rate: 1 is half a turn a second to your left (counter-clockwise from above), −1 to your right.

outputs.name: strike
outputs.doc: Fire the lance. A strike only fires when the lance is ready; once fired it runs on its own.

codes.label: strike
codes.doc: Fire if the lance is ready; ignored mid-cycle.

no_action: No thrust and no turn (a lit jet still finishes its 20-turn burn, then you fall), no strike.

stats.label: Score
stats.doc: 50 + 2 × the hit differential, within 0 to 100: 50 is even with the other robot.

stats.label: Hits
stats.doc: Lance hits landed on the other robot's body.

stats.label: Hits taken
stats.doc: The other robot's lance hits on yours.

stats.label: Power hits
stats.doc: Hits landed while your lance was still extending.

stats.label: Blocks
stats.doc: Strikes of the other robot's lance your shield caught.

stats.label: Knockouts
stats.doc: Times you touched the floor or left the arena.

stats.label: Band time
stats.doc: Share of the match you flew at 10 to 40 m: the tiebreak.

endings.label: Time up
endings.doc: The 60 seconds ran out. Every match ends this way.

facts.label: Spawn height
facts.doc: The height both robots start and respawn at.

facts.label: Spawn separation
facts.doc: The distance between the two spawn points.

facts.label: Seat 0's side
facts.doc: Which spawn seat 0 had. The arena isn't the same seen from the two spawns, so the seed deals them: half the seeds each way.

series.label: Hit differential
series.doc: Hits landed less hits taken so far.

series.label: Altitude
series.doc: Height above the floor; no sample while knocked out.

series.label: Distance
series.doc: Between the two robots; no sample while either is knocked out.

events.label: Hit
events.doc: A lance hit on a body; the event names the seat that landed it.

events.label: Power hit
events.doc: A hit landed while the lance was still extending: knockback and a stagger.

events.label: Block
events.doc: A lance struck a shield; the event names the shield's seat.

events.label: Knockout
events.doc: A robot touched the floor or left the arena.
